node.title: Re: Validating an XML file with multiple schemas
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If XML::LibXML::Schema is not the suitable module for this purpose, what's the success rate with the alternatives ?

[mod://XML::LibXML] is an interface to [http://xmlsoft.org/|libxml2], which is a very powerful library. I'd be surprised if it couldn't handle it, so I'd try going with it first. Sometimes it takes a bit of tweaking, for example [https://stackoverflow.com/a/48755635|here] I showed how to write custom code to cache external resources during DTD validation. If you have trouble with it, feel free to report back here with an [id://1177642|SSCCE] that reproduces the issue.
